paper_title: Can LLMs Solve longer Math Word Problems Better

model_annotation: This line plot illustrates the "Missing Step" metric across five discrete steps (labeled 0 through 4 on the x-axis) for two experimental conditions: one with an "extension" (orange solid line with triangle markers) and one "w.o. extension" (without extension, blue dashed line with circle markers). The y-axis, labeled "Missing Step," ranges from approximately 0.820 to 0.865 and appears to be on a linear scale with major gridlines at intervals of 0.005. The orange "extension" line begins at approximately 0.863 at step 0, then steadily declines to about 0.842 at step 4. The blue "w.o. extension" line starts lower, at approximately 0.835 at step 0, and decreases more sharply to around 0.819 by step 3, where it then plateaus through step 4. Both lines show a downward trend, indicating a reduction in the "Missing Step" value as the step number increases, with the "extension" condition consistently yielding higher (worse) values than the "w.o. extension" condition across all steps.
